title: Rethinking Agentic Model Orchestration for Time Series Forecasting

claim.summary: FairAMO evaluates TSFM orchestrators on a frozen forecast bank where each must commit a selection or weights from a fixed backtest budget before test labels are revealed, separating orchestration ability from candidate-pool strength and complementarity.

modules.name: Frozen forecast bank with commit-before-reveal orchestration
modules.scope_reason: The cached state is candidate quantile forecasts per rolling origin and the committed action is a model selection or combination weights scored by forecast error, so it is tied to the forecasting output contract.
